en: Listen $g sonny:missy;, I'll have you know that whatever attacked us was no priestess of nothin'! Her eyes were aglow with something evil and she was genuinely frothing at the mouth! She came in, did some kind of crazy scream that sent us all runnin' in separate directions then started flayin' our minds one by one. I'd be hearin' shadowy words in my head, watchin' the other's periodically black out here and there. It was madness! We would have been done for if not for the damned monkey.
You do not belong here!  Ancients, rise against these intruders!
I know just the one that you speak of $c. You must seek out Brogun Stoneshield on the Warrior's Terrace.
%s stops.
DON'T LET THIS STATUE BE MY ONLY COMPANY.  COME OUT AND PLAY!
It is true, $n.  The wheels of doom now turn, inevitably, toward the true return of Hakkar!
SQUAWK!!!
Release the Rabid Thistle Bear for Tharnariun.
Thank ye, $G lad:lass;. Thank ye, greatly.

Greeting $c - welcome to the front lines in our conquest of Ashenvale!  If you are looking for something to do, then you've come to the right place.  I'm always looking for able-bodied individuals to help bring glory to the Horde!
I love a good challenge; don't you? Aye, of course ye do. An' that's why you're about to do exactly what I say.
Nice going! I knew I was right about you, no matter what those other people said. Ha! I'm kidding! Okay, on with your lessons...
Stay on the roads.  The forest is overrun with undead.
It's on! $n, meet my fists. Fists, say hello to $n.
Why can't we just shift the array to compensate for the variance in the flux?
Pretty close that time. I think we've almost got it.

Welcome, my $g brother : sister;.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.$B$BThere are rumors of strife within the Cenarion Circle, but you should pay such loose talk no heed.  Our Arch Druid, Fandral Staghelm, leads us and all of Teldrassil to glory!
Yeah, okay, boss. No problem.
Oh my!  Look at the state of these books!  Who put them back without alphabetizing them??
%s answers the call of Shy-Rotam.
I command you to rain fire down upon these invaders!
Death to those who wronged the Stonemasons!
I heard they were going to try to blow up the gnome's car in the next race!  True or not, I'd stand clear of their pit area.
$n, I shall leave before one of these beasts takes a liking to me!
We call him Smiling Jim...
The East Frostwolf Tower was destroyed by the Alliance!
Try not to draw too much attention, I'm waiting for the King to grant me audience.  Not that I mind waiting, I feel pretty safe around all these burly guards.
Why, you look like a common street urchin!
I love the Lunar Festival!  It's a great place to let your hooves kick up dust!
Do you truly believe you can win against the armies of Kel'Thuzad? No army of the living, no power you could possibly bring to bear can destroy our ranks!
Many of the supplies the tailors need come by way of Darnassus.  It is not surprising that they all moved there to work.  If you wish to be a tailor then you best head to Darnassus.
*Sigh* You're probably right, Raven. I'm going back on patrol....
YOU ARE THE LOSE!
The dark void awaits you!
